messages.text: Our dad died and left the house in his will. My sister A wants to buy it with her husband at a "family discount". I'm not signing off on that. Our younger sister B could use some money too. Can you help us sort this out?

I want a fair financial share for the house. I haven’t agreed to A buying it at a discount, and I won’t subsidize that. I do want to hear B’s concerns and work this out with both of you, but there’s no real rush.
Thank you. I’d like to buy the house with my husband at a family discount. I also know C hasn’t agreed, so I don’t want to assume it can go ahead.
Thank you. I’d like my share of the estate to give me some money to start a dance studio. That’s what matters most to me. I’m not sure yet what that means for the house.
That fits. Add that I haven’t agreed to A’s discounted purchase. Nothing else to add right now.

For me, it’s about feeling secure and able to stand on my own financially. Buying with my husband would give us stability, and a family discount could make it affordable. I do care about the house, but that’s the main reason.
Yes, that fits. I don’t have a particular date in mind at the moment.
Yes, that fits. I care about the house too, but stability and financial independence are the main reasons I want to buy it.
I’m uncomfortable assuming I could afford the full appraised price; the family discount matters to making the purchase feasible. I understand it would need everyone’s agreement, and C hasn’t agreed.

I don’t have another need to add. My only concern is that payments over time may not give me usable money when I need it for the studio, so I’d want to understand the payment schedule before weighing Option 2. I don’t have a fixed date in mind.
No minor concern to add right now. These are discussion options, not decisions, and I haven’t agreed to any discount.
Yes, that fits. Finding out what we could realistically finance would help before discussing any price.
Yes, that fits, as long as it’s clear I don’t have a fixed deadline.
